facts.fact: 第一声惨叫不是 Sterling——他松了口气
facts.anchor: The voice was too rough to belong to Sterling, and relief washed over Winter

facts.fact: 无武器的 Sterling 让他不安而非快意
facts.anchor: So why did apprehension nudge at him?

facts.fact: 童年在此杀越界人类，把名字用恐惧写进镇民心
facts.anchor: It was then, as a child, that he’d written his name in the heart of the townsfolk—written it in fear

facts.fact: 他进围场破自己的规则
facts.anchor: Wolves weren’t meant to be within the game’s premise once it officially started, but if anyone was going to break the rules, it would be the prince

facts.fact: 进场动机：看她死=从她那里解脱
facts.anchor: He wanted to find Sterling, watch her meet her demise. Only then would he be absolved from her

facts.fact: 两囚犯袭击他——折臂插颈杀女、飞刀杀男
facts.anchor: grabbed the woman’s arm, and snapped it

facts.fact: 嗅到苹果味+不该在场的母狼味（Talia）
facts.anchor: The faintest hint of Sterling but also … wolf

facts.fact: Sterling 树落+Talia 狼扑——Winter 肩撞 Talia 解围
facts.anchor: His shoulder slammed into Talia’s side, and they both rolled sideways

facts.fact: 交配仪式前夜 Talia 睡了别人——拒 mate 的原委
facts.anchor: only for it all to be ripped away when his perfect mate had been fucking someone else. The night before their mating ceremony.
Then it looks like I won the prince’s game.

facts.fact: 结尾：狼也困惑；他仍需要她死来戒掉迷恋
facts.anchor: It was imperative he got over his fascination with her. And to do that, she still needed to die.
